g.text: Frames from the EPIC team's galleries (natural colour). DSCOVR is sunward of Earth, so in a transit it sees the Moon's sunlit far side. (b) Calibrated values: EPIC's far side (Gorkavyi et al. 2026) over Earth's July-2016 mean (Yang et al.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: 2018); the band is our adopted gamma range. Stray light inside the camera brightens Moon terrain in front of Earth by 3% (display) over the same terrain in front of space.
